title: Piping and controls—stationary tanks.
officialText:
Filling or dispensing connections on indoor stationary tanks shall be provided
with a means of local exhaust. Such exhaust shall be designed to capture fumes and vapors. The exhaust shall be directed to a
treatment system where required by the New York City Fire Code.
